analysis.summary_en: Run Claude Design on your own local agent — Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or any file‑capable coding agent.
highlights: Best with Opus 5.5. The skill is a long, demanding design brief; the stronger the model, the better the result. Pair it with Claude Opus 5.5 for the best output, and it still works well on…
"Turn this analytics CSV into a dashboard that compares the last 28 days with the 28 before."
"Use motion-director to turn this launch post into a 60‑second narrated film."
